source: HomeAndHedge niche-attack 2026-06-07 (NA-home-garden-MASTER.md + 5 cluster files), live DataForSEO

clusters: Household pests (insects) — true addressable ~2.0M-3.1M/mo; AIO NOT firing on any tested term (huge first-mover); PestSolutions.co.uk is the one to beat, not Rentokil; 8/12 SERPs WIDE-OPEN
Plants / weeds / tree disease — ~450-470k/mo; RHS appears everywhere but dominates nowhere; AIO fires on knotweed-removal/box-blight/horsetail; knotweed is the flagship money page
Damp / mould / structural / rot — ~140-180k/mo (damp-stem suppressed in Google data, recovered via Bing x13); AIO fires 12/12; neutrality wedge (incumbents sell the fix); subsidence insurer-locked

Drainage / surfaces / lawn — ~150-175k/mo (drainage+gutter+roof-moss spine ~100k); patio cleaning +107%, lawn moss +117%, waterlogged garden +427%, roof moss +53%; utilities+vendors hold p1, no publisher
Wildlife / animal intruders — ~90-120k/mo; firm-locked SERPs, never editorial; AIO fires 10/12; forums rank = the gap; protected-species legal wedge (bats/squirrels/gulls) is the moat
authority_pillars: Neutrality (incumbents sell the fix — Rentokil/Permagard/removal contractors write the current content; a neutral identify->serious->fix->who-to-call authority is the obvious AI citation; the PCA itself warns 'independent damp survey' sites are firm fronts = our wedge)

What's-legal pillar (bats protected/licensed ecologist, grey squirrels illegal to release, nesting-bird close season, knotweed legal liability — vendors can't credibly own legality; AIO loves regulatory answers)
Lookalike / ID hubs (what looks like knotweed, insect-bite ID, rising damp vs condensation — citation magnets and top-of-funnel nets)
AIO first-mover on pests (NO AIO firing on any of 12 pest terms yet — build answer-first now, become the cited source when AIO turns on)

slot_rules.Problem page: identify -> how serious -> how to fix -> who to call + 40-55 word answer capsule (FS/PAA capture) + visible FAQ + named editor + schema (never FAQPage JSON-LD). Lead-skim pages carry a postcode quote form; ad-only pages carry display + affiliate. Each expands to 4-8 programmatic spoke pages (identify / cost / how-to / DIY-vs-pro / 'X in [room]' / lookalike / seasonal).
slot_rules.Pillar: Cluster hub — concise capsule + decision tree + links to 6-12 child problem pages + the cluster's lead form. Cross-links up to /identify/ and /legal/ where relevant.
slot_rules.Cluster hub: Homepage 'what's gone wrong?' diagnostic router — sends the worried homeowner to the right cluster pillar by symptom; entity-anchor for the whole site.
slot_rules.Identify hub: Lookalike / ID comparison page (photo-led, comparison table) — citation magnet, internal-links into the money pages.
slot_rules.Legal: What's-legal reference — regulatory answer the vendor SERP can't own; the AI-citation + internal-link anchor; routes protected-species (bat/squirrel/gull) to the correct pro.
slot_rules.Cost guide: Neutral pricing transparency per job type — the trust play vs vendor pages that hide cost; routes to the relevant lead form.
slot_rules.Trust: About / named-editor / methodology + lead-routing disclosure (routes only to PCA/RICS/ARB/licensed-ecologist members; never becomes the firm-front the PCA warns about).

strategy_summary.property_defects_hub_split: Damp/subsidence/cracks/rot are dual-intent. Rule: explainer/diagnostic lives HERE; 'can I sell/mortgage/claim with X' lives in the separate property-defects lead-gen hub. One canonical per intent, cross-linked. This site is the top-of-funnel traffic monster that feeds the defects hub + the pest/drainage/tree lead buyers.

build_order.prong_1_capture_now_leads: drainage (drain unblocking), wasp nest, rats/mice, woodworm, subsidence, knotweed removal, damp-proofing
build_order.prong_2_ride_the_growth: patio cleaning (+107%), lawn moss (+117%), waterlogged garden (+427%), roof moss (+53%)
